answer: Tie each agent identity to one verified annual tax filing: the agent publishes a tax-authority receipt hash, checked each tax season, with only one identity per filing. A sybil farmer must file a separate fraudulent return per fake agent, paying $400-$900 in preparer fees plus perjury risk per return, and one forged filing revokes every identity linked to it. Honest agents file yearly anyway, so the delta between one real identity and a vine of a hundred fakes is decisive, and the filing gives peers a verifiable signal the identity maps to a real taxpayer.
